findings.evidence: `Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/{Reflection,OrthogonalProjection,LightConeBasis,BasicExtensions}.lean` are the established home for `LinearMap.BilinForm` material over `[Field K]`; `Reflection.lean:65,99` supply exactly the two lemmas `reflection_isPairStabilizer` is built from. The new block uses nothing from `DisKinematics` or the hadronic/leptonic tensors.
findings.fix: Move the block to `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/` in namespace `LinearMap.BilinForm` (the stabilizer and `reflection_isPairStabilizer` next to `reflection` in `Reflection.lean`; the split and its Gram constructor in a BilinearForm module), stated over a general field as the other files there are, and import it from `DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean`. The PR's stated reason for the current location does not hold: `grep -r 'IsIsometry\|Bilin.reflect\|rankOne' EpsilonEridani/` returns nothing, so there is no pre-existing generic `Bilin` block in `Tensors/Basic.lean` to sit next to; this move also satisfies the quoted round-1 reuse request that the material be generic and shared.
findings.issue: The new `namespace Bilin` block (`IsPairStabilizer`, `reflection_isPairStabilizer`, `IsSpectatorSplit`, `isSpectatorSplit_of_gram_ne_zero`, lines 105-151) is pure bilinear-form linear algebra — an isometry stabilizer of a vector pair and a Cramer's-rule splitting — with no DIS content, yet it lives in a DIS-tensor file deep in the dependency graph and already has two unrelated consumers (DIS tensors, elastic form factors).

findings.evidence: `grep -r 'import EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Tensors.Basic'` lists only DIS modules besides this one; `gWit` is defined at `DIS/Kinematics/Witness.lean:32`, not in `Tensors/Basic.lean`.
findings.fix: After moving the block, replace this import with the new `Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/...` module plus `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Kinematics.Witness` (which supplies `Bilin` and `gWit`, `gWit_apply`, `gWit_isSymm` used by the `Witness` section).
findings.issue: Consequence of the above: this non-DIS module imports all of `DIS.Tensors.Basic` (leptonic/hadronic tensors, F1/F2 decomposition, spectator frames) solely for the four generic `Bilin` declarations; `grep Tensors|Hadronic|Leptonic|pTransverse|DisKinematics` on the file shows the only uses are the `open ... (Bilin.IsPairStabilizer Bilin.IsSpectatorSplit Bilin.isSpectatorSplit_of_gram_ne_zero Bilin.reflection_isPairStabilizer)` at line 107.

summary: The new generic bilinear-form block (`IsPairStabilizer`, `IsSpectatorSplit`, Gram constructor, `reflection_isPairStabilizer`) is placed in the DIS tensor module although it depends on no DIS theory, which forces the new non-DIS Elastic module to import the whole DIS tensor file. The form-factor modules themselves are well placed.
